[INTRO DATE

ORDINANCE SEPT 25, 2078

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 9-G in the area bounded by

North Clark Street; a line 50 feet northwest of and parallel to West Patterson
Avenue; the public alley next southwest of and parallel to North Clark
Street; and a line 85 feet northwest of and parallel to West Patterson Avenue

to those of a Cl1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3650 North Clark Street
